# People strip (`people-strip`)

People and their whereabouts (home, away, a zone) as avatars with how long they have been there.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createPeopleStrip` (types in `dist/web/home/security/peopleStrip.d.ts`): `ul.mh-people-strip` (`--compact`: avatars only): one `__person--home | --away | --zone | --unknown` per entry, each a `__main` (a `<button>` with `onSelect`) holding the `__face` (the avatar and a `__badge` icon for where they are) and `__text` (`__name`, `__place` with how long). People at home are lit; the others are dimmed. The list is named "People, 2 of 3 home". It scrolls sideways when there are more people than room.

```ts
export function createPeopleStrip(options: PeopleStripOptions): PeopleStripHandle;

export interface PeopleStripOptions {
  people: readonly PersonEntry[];
  /** Avatars only, the words spoken but not shown (watches, narrow strips). */
  compact?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<PeopleStripLabels>;
  /** Makes each person a button (open their details). */
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
}

export interface PeopleStripHandle {
  el: HTMLUListElement;
  update(changes: Partial<PeopleStripOptions>): void;
}

export interface PersonEntry {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** A picture URL; initials show without one. */
  picture?: string;
  where: PersonWhere;
  /** The place's name when `where` is `zone`. */
  zone?: string;
  /** How long they have been there, as the app words it ("2 h", "since 08:10"). */
  since?: string;
}

export interface PeopleStripLabels {
  /** Accessible name of the strip. */
  label: string;
  home: string;
  away: string;
  unknown: string;
  /** Added to the strip's name: `{n}` at home out of `{total}`. */
  summary: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createPeopleStrip, type PersonEntry } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const people: PersonEntry[] = [
  { id: 'robin', name: 'Robin Vale', where: 'home', since: '2 h' },
  { id: 'kit', name: 'Kit Harrow', where: 'zone', zone: 'Studio', since: '25 min' },
  { id: 'ash', name: 'Ash Merrow', where: 'away', since: '3 h' },
];

const strip = createPeopleStrip({
  people,
  onSelect: (id) => console.log('Show details for', id),
});

// Later someone arrives home: hand over the new list.
setTimeout(() => {
  const kit: PersonEntry = { id: 'kit', name: 'Kit Harrow', where: 'home', since: 'Just now' };
  strip.update({ people: people.map((p) => (p.id === kit.id ? kit : p)) });
}, 3000);

document.body.append(strip.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { PeopleStrip } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { PersonEntry } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const PEOPLE: PersonEntry[] = [
  { id: 'robin', name: 'Robin Vale', where: 'home', since: '2 h' },
  { id: 'kit', name: 'Kit Harrow', where: 'zone', zone: 'Studio', since: '25 min' },
  { id: 'ash', name: 'Ash Merrow', where: 'away', since: '3 h' },
];

export function PeopleStripExample() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const person = PEOPLE.find((p) => p.id === selected);
  return (
    <>
      <PeopleStrip people={PEOPLE} onSelect={setSelected} />
      {person && <p>Selected {person.name}</p>}
    </>
  );
}
```
